collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a young adult)

collection.description: A young villager must do a job alone while their teacher watches: ask the teacher to look away, or do it while watched.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been learning from (friend) for a whole season. Today (friend) has asked (subject.him/her) to do the job alone while (friend.he/she) watches. (subject)'s hands are sweating. (subject.He/she) knows how to do it. (subject.He/she) has done it many times. But now (friend) is watching, and (subject) can't think about anything except disappointing (friend.him/her).

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) does it with (friend) watching. (subject.His/her) hands shake. (subject.He/she) makes one small mistake and fixes it. When it's done, (friend) says, "You made a mistake and fixed it without panicking. That's the most important part." (subject) had been bracing for something much worse. It takes (subject.him/her) a while to believe it.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "Could you not watch?" says (subject). "Just for a bit." (friend) laughs, and turns around, and sits facing the other way. (subject) does the job. It goes well. When (friend) turns back, (friend.he/she) looks it over carefully and nods. "Good," (friend.he/she) says. That one word carries (subject) through the whole week.
